segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so for the Tuesday pipeline scrub, can you sanity check my Midwest accounts? I’ve got the seat counts cleaned up but the services lines are a little messy.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Sure. Which ones are you worried about?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Brightlane is straightforward: 84 users today, asking for 12 more editor seats, go-live on September 9. Pricing sheet has them at $68 per editor if we keep the same tier.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Yep, quote the 12 seats annual, no discount approval needed. Just make sure deal desk sees the updated order form before you send it.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Will do. Northstar’s term in the billing tool runs through tomorrow, and the CRM is basically quiet after that June support handoff, so I’m leaving them out of commit.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: They want quarterly invoicing because their AP cutoff is the 20th. Total is $41,760 for the year, 55 seats, with the onboarding package split out at $3,500.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: That’s fine, but put net 30 in the notes. Finance bounced one last week when the payment terms only showed on the PDF.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Got it. Last one is Cobalt Tooling. Procurement asked if we can align the start date to August 15 even though legal already redlined the MSA for August 1.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Use August 15 on the order form, keep the MSA date as-is. If they push back, route it through legal, not deal desk.
